from pathlib import Path
import bpy,json,hashlib
out=Path(r'D:\Dev\vibeGamingDemo1\ThreeHearthsVillage\Art\ToolKit')
with bpy.data.libraries.load(str(out/'ToolKit.blend'),link=False) as (src,dst):
    report={'source_blend':'ToolKit.blend','objects':sorted(src.objects),'meshes':sorted(src.meshes),'materials':sorted(src.materials),'armatures':list(src.armatures),'actions':list(src.actions)}
assert len(report['objects'])==16 and len(report['meshes'])==8
assert not report['armatures'] and not report['actions']
assert all(name.startswith('tool_') for name in report['objects'])
assert all(name.startswith('TK_') for name in report['materials'])
report.update({'original_tools_only':True,'licensed_character_geometry_in_source':False,'source_blend_sha256':hashlib.sha256((out/'ToolKit.blend').read_bytes()).hexdigest()})
(out/'source-audit.json').write_text(json.dumps(report,indent=2)+'\n',encoding='utf-8')
print('TOOL_SOURCE_AUDIT_PASSED')
